name: Huntington Bancshares

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (Huntington Bancshares Inc. logo.svg)

description: Huntington is a Columbus, Ohio regional bank holding company ($225.1B of assets, $176.6B of deposits at 2025-12-31) that lends to consumers, small businesses and commercial clients in the Midwest and increasingly beyond, marketing itself on 'Fair Play' customer-friendly banking. It earns 73 percent of revenue from net interest income (spread on loans and deposits) and the rest from fees on cards, payments, treasury services and wealth management. It is growing by acquisition: Veritex (Dallas) closed 2025-10-20 and Cadence Bank (Houston and Tupelo) closed 2026-02-01, neither fully in the 2025 numbers.

businessLines.how: Consumers and small-to-mid-sized businesses pay loan interest (direct and indirect consumer, dealer finance, mortgage, home equity, SBA) and fees for deposits, cards, payments, treasury services, wealth management and brokerage through branches, digital and partner channels; 74 percent of revenue is net interest income (4,127 of 5,551, computed).
